purpose: Narrow pre-FTCR validation of independently derived mixed-income component arithmetic, including ordering, pension interactions, Personal Allowance taper, HICBC and annual Self Assessment student-loan components. This pack does not validate a complete annual bill, amount due, reserve figure, foreign tax credit, evidence precedence or customer presentation.

review.reviewer: Codex independent Tranche H assurance review stream
review.notes: HMX-001 and HMX-002 approved only within their narrow pre-FTCR component purposes after independent source, applicability, arithmetic and rounding review. HMX-003 is not included or admitted. See docs/TRANCHE_H_INDEPENDENT_ASSURANCE_REVIEW.md, docs/TRANCHE_H_SOURCE_AUTHORITY_NOTE.md and docs/ANNUAL_STUDENT_LOAN_SOURCE_AUTHORITY.md.

rounding: Income Tax and Class 4 amounts are fixed to pounds and pence. For each applicable annual Self Assessment student-loan plan, the calculated repayment is rounded down to a whole pound before that plan's evidenced deduction is subtracted. HICBC percentage steps, benefit amount and charge are rounded down as stated in the derivations and cited authority.

derivation: Gross RaS pension reduces ANI to 55000 and extends the basic-rate band from 37700 to 42700
Non-savings income is 55000; after PA, 42430 is taxed at 20%, giving 8486
Total taxable income exceeds the extended basic band, so PSA is 500; 1500 savings is taxed at 40%, giving 600
After the 500 Dividend Allowance, 2500 dividends are taxed at 35.75%, giving 893.75
Foreign tax is recorded but FTCR is not calculated; pre-credit Income Tax is 9979.75
Class 4 is 6% of sole-trade profit above 12570: 2430 at 6% is 145.80
ANI is not over 60000, so HICBC is zero
PAYE tax deducted is evidence and does not reduce the independently stated annual Income Tax liability
limitations: This validates pre-FTCR mixed-income components only, not a complete annual bill, amount due or reserve figure
UK and foreign property inputs are assumed to be valid taxable profits and no unmodelled losses or reliefs alter section 23 income
The gross relief-at-source pension amount is assumed to qualify for relief
Foreign Tax Credit Relief is deliberately not calculated
Employment tax evidence is not assigned a confidence or precedence classification

derivation: Gross RaS pension reduces ANI to 103000; PA falls by 1500 to 11070 and the basic-rate band extends to 47700
Non-savings income is 110000; taxable non-savings is 98930: 47700 at 20% and 51230 at 40%, giving 30032
Higher-rate PSA is 500; the remaining 500 savings is taxed at 40%, giving 200
After the 500 Dividend Allowance, 1500 dividends are taxed at 35.75%, giving 536.25
Pre-credit Income Tax is 30032 + 200 + 536.25 = 30768.25
Class 4 is 7430 at 6%, giving 445.80
ANI is at least 80000 and the taxpayer is the higher-ANI partner, so HICBC is 100% of benefit, floored to 1406
Annual loan income after gross pension is 103000; Plan 2 is 9% of 73615 = 6625.35, floored to 6625
PGL is 6% of 82000 = 4920; combined annual liability is 11545
Separate evidenced deductions of 3000 and 1800 leave 3625 Plan 2 and 3120 PGL, combined 6745
limitations: This validates pre-FTCR mixed-income and annual student-loan components only, not a complete annual bill, amount due or reserve figure
Loan calculations are annual Self Assessment liabilities, not payroll-period deduction calculations
All stated property, savings and dividend amounts are assumed to be valid step-1 taxable income; unearned income exceeds £2,000 so the whole relevant amount is included
The full gross relief-at-source pension amount is assumed to receive qualifying relief and not already be excluded from total income
The Child Benefit amount assumes a full benefit period and the taxpayer is assumed to be the higher-ANI partner
This fixture covers one undergraduate plan plus a postgraduate plan and must not be generalised to simultaneous multiple-undergraduate-plan selection
Foreign Tax Credit Relief is deliberately not calculated
No policy confidence label is assigned to payroll evidence
